# Native duplicate-support diagnostic

This scratch-only workflow does not modify the product branch. It instruments
the fresh local certified preparation boundary to omit one consecutive,
structurally identical, unattributed can-call assumption. The same support
command remains immediately before the actual check. Neither terms, fuel nor
facts are removed from that check's context. Unsupported expression kinds retain
the original command. Unresolved function names are compared explicitly.

The selected declaration names bound the diagnostic experiment; they are not a
proposed product policy. Native controls must reproduce the accepted current
build's outcome/resource vectors and captured queries before causal conclusions.
False-entry controls must remain genuinely Invalid. Every actual assertion and
branch-transfer object remains untouched. Normal product workflows do not enable
this instrumentation, and it supplies no product or whole-suite acceptance.
